# Raw observations

These are the final five-process observations used by [the measurement report](local-measurements.md).
A pilot run motivated the shared-collector control. Pilot data is not pooled into these results.

Mode `0` is the direct iterator. Mode `4` is the direct shared collector. Mode `1` is RowFn with
reused arguments. Mode `2` uses fresh arguments. Mode `3` repeats the direct iterator as a control.

Within each process and size, sample indices run from `0` through `31`. Each listed value is the
reported nanoseconds per complete call for that sample. All modes use the same repetition count
within a process and size. Pair observations by process, size, and sample index.

## Per-process paired summaries

All differences are medians of 32 pairwise differences, in nanoseconds. The control ratio is a
median of 32 pairwise ratios. These are not differences or ratios of separately aggregated medians.
